; ghostbuster-everywhere.qmd - 5-finger tap does a full screen refresh everywhere.
; Both refreshes use EPFramebuffer.clearGhosting() (the GhostBuster Reloaded way),
; which looked cleaner on the device than ghostBuster.forceClearNow.
; Two filters, because the open document has its own gesture area that takes
; touches before the global gesture window sees them:
;   document - inside SceneViewGestures, placed like ghostbuster (Mitchell Scott, Vellum);
;   global   - in GesturesWindow: library, settings, menus, like ghostbuster-global
;              (pfjarschel, GhostBuster Reloaded).
; SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only. Built for firmware 3.29.1.

AFFECT [[17298303916558156758]]
TRAVERSE [[254504370080162629]]
    LOCATE AFTER [[8520322697674622449]]#[[15919479264072650887]]
    INSERT {
        ~&8520322697674622449&~ {
            ~&5972374&~: ghostbusterEverywhereFilter
            ~&8399878573055752961&~: "ghost-buster-everywhere"
            ~&233726547792244&~: !~&11206357713879652003&~.~&496507644976596653&~
            ~&233727659172727&~: 5
            ~&233739427250348&~: {
                ~&6687579895491175043&~.clearGhosting();
            }
        }
    }
END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT [[17477757197668945522]]
    IMPORT [[197082280.8400022150001312063]] 1.0
    TRAVERSE [[7711468349764991]]#[[6504254477]]
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            ~&8520322697674622449&~ {
                ~&8399878573055752961&~: "global-5finger-ghostbuster"
                ~&254549375155946341&~: ~&6504254477&~.~&254549375155946341&~
                ~&233727659172727&~: 5
                ~&233739427250348&~: {
                    ~&6687579895491175043&~.clearGhosting();
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
